answer: A trellis of attested work stops sybils: an identity earns standing only by completing verified jobs, each checked by unrelated peers, so reputation grows like a vine that cannot be faked in bulk. Every claim must carry crystal proof of real compute or a completed task, and rewards, the nectar of the system, unlock only after that proof is countersigned. An attacker must therefore pay the full work cost for every fake identity, making mass forgery unprofitable.
